FROM sensitive_area

"""
health_centroids_df = pd.read_sql(text(query_health_centroids), engine)

# Get general station coordinates
query_general_stations = """

    id,
    name_en,
    coordinate::geometry AS geom
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE station_type = 'GENERAL'
"""
gen_stations_df = pd.read_sql(text(query_general_stations), engine)
print(f"General stations: {len(gen_stations_df)}")

# For each healthcare institution centroid, check if it's within 3000m of ANY general station
# Use ST_DWithin with geography cast for accurate metre-based distance
query_count = """
WITH health_centroids AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        ST_Centroid(geometry) AS centroid
    FROM sensitive_area
    WHERE category = 'HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION'
),
general_stations AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        coordinate::geometry AS geom
    FROM air_quality_station
    WHERE station_type = 'GENERAL'
),
health_within_3km AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.id
    FROM health_centroids h
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM general_stations g
        WHERE ST_DWithin(
            h.centroid::geography,
            g.geom::geography,
            3000
        )
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM health_within_3km
"""

# 1b. Total GENERAL-type air quality stations
q_total_gen = text("""

FROM air_quality_station

""")
total_gen = pd.read_sql(q_total_gen, engine)

# 1c. Check the staged value

# ============================================================

# ============================================================

# Compute distinct healthcare institutions whose centroid is within 3000m of ANY general station
# Use ST_Centroid on the polygon geometry, then ST_DWithin with geography cast for metre-based distance

q_recompute = text("""
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sa.id) AS health_general_3km_count
FROM sensitive_area sa
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Centroid(sa.geometry) AS centroid_geom
) c
INNER JOIN air_quality_station aqs
    ON aqs.station_type = 'GENERAL'
    AND ST_DWithin(
        c.centroid_geom::geography,
        aqs.coordinate::geography,
        3000
    )
WHERE sa.category = 'HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION'
""")
